problem:
Which of the following equalities are true given that
$D={(x,y)\,:\,1\le x\le 2,\,\frac{1}{2}\le y\le 1}.$

- ${∬}_{D}y\operatorname{ln}⁡(x)\,\text{d}A={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{1/2}^{1}y\operatorname{ln}⁡(x)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y$
- ${∬}_{D}y\operatorname{ln}⁡(x)\,\text{d}A={\int }_{1/2}^{1}{\int }_{1}^{2}y\operatorname{ln}⁡(x)\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x$
- ${∬}_{D}y\operatorname{ln}⁡(x)\text{d}A={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{1/2}^{1}y\operatorname{ln}⁡(x)\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x$
worked_solution:
We notice that:

- the limits for the variable $x$ are from $1$ to $2$, and

- the limits for the variable $y$ are from $\frac{1}{2}$ to $1.$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}y\operatorname{ln}⁡(x)\,\text{d}A & ={\int }_{1/2}^{1}[{\int }_{1}^{2}y\operatorname{ln}⁡(x)\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, since the region of integration is rectangular, we can simply swap the order of integration. This gives

$$
{∬}_{D}y\operatorname{ln}⁡(x)\,\text{d}A={\int }_{1}^{2}[{\int }_{1/2}^{1}y\operatorname{ln}⁡(x)\,\text{d}y]\text{d}x.
$$

So, the correct answer is "III only".
